emails.subject: Brand refresh: kickoff call + contract
emails.body:
Hi Daniel,

Good news: we've signed off on the brand refresh proposal, and Tom has countersigned the contract.

Could we set up a 60-minute kickoff call the week after next? I could do:
- Tuesday 13 Oct, any time between 10:00 and 12:00
- Wednesday 14 Oct, 14:00-16:00
- Thursday 15 Oct, 09:00-10:30

Could you also send me a copy of the signed contract for our records? Finance need it before they can process the 50% deposit.

Thanks,
Priya

Priya Raman | Marketing Lead | Halden & Rowe
0161 496 0732

emails.subject: Countersigned: Brand refresh agreement
emails.body:
Daniel,

Please find the countersigned agreement attached. Priya will be your day-to-day contact from here.

Best,
Tom Ashby
Operations Director, Halden & Rowe
